audit.whatIsWrong: Level rows 3 and 4 were given to Akali and level 6 to Graves, while the page's own whys[2]/whys[3] call those stages even and whys[4] says level 6 is where she flips the lane. Packet chart reads Graves/Skill/Skill/Skill/Akali/Akali/Graves.
audit.why: The sides contradicted both the packet chart and the prose in the same file. Levels 3-5 are energy-gated and genuinely even; level 6 is hers the moment Perfect Execution exists.
audit.corrected: Level 3 and Levels 4-5 are Skill (5/10); Level 6 is Akali (4/10). Late rows stay Akali because her scaling prose is correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Akali's ultimate was called 'Shadow Dance' in whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.foe[0]. Her R is Perfect Execution. No cooldowns were attached to the spikes.
audit.why: Data Dragon lists R as Perfect Execution, 120/90/60s. Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1 — the whole 'wait for the window' advice needed those numbers.
audit.corrected: Perfect Execution (R, 120s at rank 1) is the level-6 spike; Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1, so the commit window is real and repeatable, not rare.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twilight Shroud was repeatedly described as making Akali 'untargetable'.
audit.why: Riot's description says she becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks — that is unselectable, not untargetable. Ground-placed and non-selecting effects still reach her, which is exactly why dropping Smoke Screen on the cloud works.
audit.corrected: Inside Shroud she is invisible and cannot be selected — your autos, Q and R lose their target, but Smoke Screen lands on the ground and still denies the zone. Attacking or casting reveals her, so the fight restarts the instant she acts.
sources: mirrorFindings notes (akali side flagged the same wording)

audit.whatIsWrong: No punishable cooldown named with a number.
audit.why: Five Point Strike is on a 1.5s cooldown but costs 110 energy at rank 1 — she is energy-gated, not cooldown-gated, and a whiffed Q is the real punish window.
audit.corrected: Punish the energy, not the cooldown: Five Point Strike costs 110 at rank 1, so two whiffed Qs leave her unable to Shuriken Flip out.

edits.after: Even: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 — punish the whiff before Twilight Shroud resets it.

edits.after: True Grit stacks for you, but Twilight Shroud (W, 20s at rank 1) cancels any all-in — trade only in its downtime, two autos and out.

edits.before: Level 6 flips the lane. Shadow Dance gives her two charged dashes plus an execute, so the trade you were comfortably winning at 5 now turns lethal the second you drop below her R threshold — she dashes in, executes, and dashes out of shell range before you can reload. Your Eclipse/Youmuu's spike does land around her first AP item, so you're not helpless, but every all-in has to wait for her Twilight Shroud to be down — while it's up she's untargetable and your shells, Q, and R have nothing to hit. Commit your E+Q+R burst only when her W is on cooldown; force a fight into an up shroud and you just feed her energy and a reset.
edits.after: Level 6 flips the lane. Perfect Execution gives her two charged dashes plus an execute, so the trade you were comfortably winning at 5 now turns lethal the second you drop below her R threshold — she dashes in, executes, and dashes out of shell range before you can reload. Your Eclipse/Youmuu's spike does land around her first AP item, so you're not helpless, but every all-in waits on Twilight Shroud (20s at rank 1) — inside it she cannot be selected and your shells, Q and R have nothing to hit. Commit E+Q+R only in that 20-second gap; force a fight into an up shroud and you feed her a free reset.

notes: REAL FABRICATED NAME FOUND: Akali's ultimate was written as 'Shadow Dance' in four places — Data Dragon says Perfect Execution. All four corrected. Packet defect flagging 'Use Twilight Shroud' as a wrong name is a FALSE POSITIVE (the name is right), but that line's 'untargetable' claim was wrong and is fixed — Riot says invisible and unable to be selected. Packet levelChart gives the 2+ items row to Graves; I left it as Akali because every prose line in the file says she out-scales him, and 64 Emerald+ games is too thin to overturn that. Flagging for the user rather than flipping it silently.
